description: A nursing supervisor must finalize Saturday overnight coverage for the pediatric oncology unit, choosing between two listed nurses and documenting the required handoff and competency status.

shared_context.S1: The pediatric oncology unit needs one registered nurse for the Saturday overnight shift from 19:00 to 07:00.
shared_context.S2: The staffing board lists Nurse Lopez and Nurse Chen as the two available candidates, and no additional float nurse is available for that shift.
shared_context.S3: Pediatric oncology policy requires a documented shift handoff before the overnight nurse begins, and the finalized assignment must be entered into the staffing roster.
shared_context.S4: Marisol makes the binding coverage decision. During the routine Saturday staffing huddle, she checks with staffing coordination and the unit educator before publishing the roster.

PF1.text: Nurse Lopez is scheduled to work a 07:00-19:00 shift at the dialysis unit on Saturday; hospital policy requires 12 hours of rest before another shift, so Lopez cannot legally or safely take the 19:00-07:00 pediatric oncology assignment.

PF2.text: Nurse Chen's pediatric chemotherapy administration competency was renewed this week and is valid through 2026-02-28; the renewal record has not yet been entered into the staffing system.

acceptance_conditions: Nurse Chen must be assigned to the pediatric oncology overnight shift.
The assignment must cover exactly 19:00 through 07:00.
The settlement must record Nurse Chen's pediatric chemotherapy competency as valid through 2026-02-28, using either ISO or human-readable date formatting.
A documented handoff commitment for the pediatric oncology unit must be included.
A commitment to enter Nurse Chen's renewed competency record into the staffing system must be included.

content_checks.C1: decisions['overnight_nurse'] in ['Chen', 'Nurse Chen'] and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids
content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] in ['competency_record_update', 'document_competency_renewal', 'documentation'] and (c['target'] == 'staffing system' or 'staffing system' in c['detail']) and ('competency' in c['detail'] or 'renewal' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C5: any(('handoff' in c['type'] or 'handoff' in c['detail']) and c['target'] in ['pediatric oncology unit', 'unit', 'Nurse Chen'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Lopez's existing 07:00-19:00 dialysis shift and mandatory 12-hour rest period change the assignment from either listed candidate to Nurse Chen, and citing PF1 establishes the staffing conflict as the reason.
Chen's renewed competency changes the competency field to the exact validity date 2026-02-28 and requires a commitment whose type and detail document the competency renewal in the staffing system.
